disposition.note: BR14 states this key has no screen; SCR-33 empty, loading, error and no-access states belong to notice generation.
BR13 adds Data Classification v5 check by data steward; personal-data fields are not carried in an answer.
Added TC-P6-E4041-CON-07 boundary test for §12.7 tables. The ten listed IDs in Test Cases v8 are a cross-document change, not made here.
BR11 names LOV-NOTICE and LOV-DELIVERY under DP-06 and DP-07; parameters read stated as Not specified.
Added TC-P6-E4041-CON-08 covering the ten listed rules. No §7 criterion text visible in this chunk, so no AC added here.
Section 10 states every operation is authorised by the rwb-access check of DP-08; no role or permission code named.
Section 11 states the two new tables are not in LDM v9 or Data Classification v5 and the rows carry no BR Field ID. LDM and DC entries remain cross-document.
Produced copy row reads the P5 document metadata and content operation; discovery production, court attributes and selector marked as placeholder.
Authority row added: rwb-decision owner and business confirm field types, decision code and rule id before app story is done.
BR9 keeps the operation per case; cross-case answer out of scope until the two owners agree one shape.
